Mr. Muhammad Kamran Baloch, AAG along with SIP Nazeer
Ahmed, PS Taimuria.
Ms. Anam Iqbal, APG.
SIP Nazeer Ahmed files comments / reports along with set of
documents on behalf of SHO PS Taimuria as well as SDPO Shadman Sub-
Division, Karachi-Central on behalf of SSP Karachi Central, which are taken
on record. Per their comments, the alleged detenue Shahnawaz Magsi has
been shown arrested under Crime No. 535/2026 under Sections 411, 412
and 413 PPC registered with PS Taimuria, Karachi, therefore, purpose of
filing this petition has been served and they seek disposal of instant
petition.
When confronted, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the
body: alleged detenue was taken away from his home. However, he is at liberty to approach the Court below where the case against him is pending and to file appropriate application in terms of allegations he has averred in the instant petition. As far as this petition is concerned, in view of the above documentary evidence submitted by the official respondents today, the purpose of filing this petition has been over, which is hereby dismissed. JUDGE HEAD OF CONST. BENCHES JUDGE Azeem
